sources.snippet: Overview Fallen-Gemma3-27B-v1 is a 27-billion parameter text-to-text model developed by TheDrummer that functions as a modified variant of Google's Gemma 3 27B with an "evil tune" that removes safety guardrails while maintaining instruction-following capability. sources.title: Fallen-Gemma3-27B-v1 | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: What is Fallen-Gemma3-27B-v1? Fallen-Gemma3-27B-v1 is a specialized fine-tune of the Gemma 3 27B model, designed to explore darker and more antagonistic conversation patterns. This model represents an experimental approach to AI interaction by removing typical ethical constraints while maintaining the original model's vision capabilities.
